notes.title: DEADLOKK - PATCH NOTES - v0.8.0
notes.notes:
It has been a very long time since our last update, but it is finally here. This update retires our PVP mode, but does bring a full co-op PVE experience.

There are two years worth of changes to the game. A complete makeover of the UI, new NPCs, Items, Ships, Starmap, Carriers and so much more!

Enjoy!

notes.title: DEADLOKK - PATCH NOTES - v0.7.0
notes.notes:
A new update has been released for Deadlokk! In this update our patch notes are limited due to the large amount of changes, additions and improvements we’ve made over the last few months. We’ve made countless changes to the game and hope to make more soon! We have a brief overview of all the changes below:

- New Ships: Koltol and Chaenom
- New Unlockable Ships:  Saint, Apocrita, Black Ops Lamna, Disciple (Starting Ship)
- New Impact Effects
- New Turret Models
- New Expedition Locations
- New EMP Status Effect Added
- New Boss Voice Lines
- New Drone Launchers
- Added Odyssey Gates which enable Item Extraction. Giving players the ability to take in items to Expedition they have saved, risk them and potentially extract with more!
- New Blockades added for Main-Line systems if you have bad Notoriety with the owner faction
- New Turret SFX for Missile Launcher, Projectile Turrets and Railguns
- Performance Improvements
- Location Discovery System
- Observatory Locations
- Beam VFX changed by weapon types
- Carrier Mining
- Consecutive Hits Effects added to all weapons, in replacement of the turret-added additional effects
- Loot Table Rework
- NPCs Attempt Warp-Out under certain conditions
- Warp Inhibition Mines
- All Ships have been given secondary abilities (apart from Starting Ships)
- Basic (Non-Harvestable) Asteroid Destruction
- New Environment Clouds
- Auto-Recast enabled by default
- Projectile VFX change based on weapon’s primary damage type
- Expedition Map Size Increased
- Server Host authentication improvements
- Many, many more bug fixes and performance improvements

notes.title: DEADLOKK - v0.6.5 - Hotfix
notes.notes:
We've deployed a hotfix to address some issues getting into games in the tutorial. We’ve also addressed issues with NPC behaviour, lighting performance and some minor changes to loot drop tables.
We have a bigger content patch coming very soon, but this is to address most of the major issues immediately.

notes.title: DEADLOKK - PATCH NOTES - v0.6.4
notes.notes:
Hello! Another small update to fix some issues with hosting lobbies and thrusters. Introducing two new ships, new locations new skyboxes!

[h2]ITEMS, CO-PILOTS & CARRIER UPGRADES[/h2]

[b]Large Seeking Missile[/b]
[list]
[*] Explosion force reduced from 2,500 to 1,050
[/list]

[b]Goliath[/b]
[list]
[*] Mining Laser added which will harvest nearby harvestable asteroids automatically
[*] Warnings now appear if the carrier energy is too low, which when clicked takes you where to 
[/list]

[h2]MECHANICS[/h2]

[b]Impact Damage[/b]
[list]
[*] Decreased the threshold of impact to cause damage by 20%
[*] Increase the amount of occurred damage from impacts by 10%
[/list]

[b]Status Effects[/b]
[list]
[*] New EMP Status effect, which when applied unlocks all targets, including drone’s targets and stops all regeneration effects for the duration (energy, shield hull)
[/list]

[h2]SHIPS[/h2]

[b]Kolotl [Frigate  - Offensive-Utility][/b]
The Kolotl is equipped with an EMP device, designed to stop ships regenerating energy and break locks on hit targets. On entering combat the Kolotl gains a boost of energy regeneration but always increases the energy cost of all abilities.
[list]
[*] Active Slots: 3
[*] Upgrade Slots: 3 
[/list]
Intrinsic Passive: Combat Adaptive Reactor
[list]
[*] When entering combat gain 25 bonus energy regeneration for 15 seconds
[*] Increase the cost of all abilities by 20%
[/list]
Intrinsic Active (W): 'Sting' EMP Cannon
[list]
[*] Fire an EMP bolt applying EMP to  the target for 5 seconds
[*] Cooldown 12s
[/list]

[b]Nezara [Frigate  - Defensive-Support][/b]
The Nezara is a drone ship designed to launch drones which have the capability to restore hull to nearby damaged allies, including other drones.
[list]
[*] Active Slots: 4
[*] Upgrade Slots: 2 
[/list]
Intrinsic Passive: Drone Repair Augmentation
[list]
[*] Drones Launched have the ability to repair nearby ship’s hull
[*] Repair 60hp every 5 seconds
[/list]

[b]Arbor [Frigate - Recon][/b]
[list]
[*] Probes Launched from the Arbor now apply EMP periodically instead of unlocking the locks of nearby targets
[/list]

[h2]EXPEDITION CHANGES[/h2]

[b]Scale Factor[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased from 1.015% per minute to 1.02%, this is the value it was before the nerf to scale factor in general, however the reduction remains the same
[/list]

[b]Mining[/b]
[list]
[*] Basic mining added to PVE, carrier automatically harvests asteroids. Further plans for this in the future
[/list]

[b]Locations[/b]
[list]
[*] New locations added, further plans for more content coming soon
[*] Some older location environments updated
[/list]

[b]Systems[/b]
[list]
[*] Now come with randomized skyboxes, this was in the game previously by not implemented
[/list]

[b]Items[/b]
[list]
[*] Generated afterburners now randomize with high speed bonuses
[*] Generated weapons will no longer generate with Slow or Immobilizing effects
[*] Generated weapons now spawn with ‘consecutive hit’ effects, which apply Slow or Immobilize after repeated hits on the same target
[/list]

[h2]VFX, SFX & UI[/h2]

[b][VFX] Impact Effects[/b]
[list]
[*] Impact effects have been added to various weapon types and asteroids
[*] Signature Increase impact effect visual changed
[/list]

[b][VFX] Camera[/b]
[list]
[*] Locking the camera now shows a faint border around the screen
[/list]

[b][VFX] Faction Logos[/b]
[list]
[*] Empyrean Logo updated
[*] Innokkulum Logo updated
[/list]

[b][SFX] Music[/b]
[list]
[*] New Soundtrack added
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the local player’s portrait in the main menu to duplicate
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed ships to get outside the map bounds based on their collider
[*] Various tooltip spacing issues fixed
[*] Harpax wreckage size now is the correct size in comparison to the ship
[*] Fixed an issue causing replicator windows not to sync properly with other players accessing it
[*] Fixed an issue causing vision clouds to block mouse interactions
[*] Fixed an issue where the carrier’s warp location is now present on all allies’ maps
[*] Fixed an issue causing dragged items from a stored ship could not be stacked if dragged onto another item in a inventory
[*] Fixed an issue causing co-pilot skills again double stacks
[*] AI orbits now are more in line with their set values
[*] Objectives and bosses can no longer spawn inside other locations
[*] Fixed textures on some asteroids to look less squished
[*] Fixed an issue which causes thrusters to not visually look correct and cause performance issues
[*] Fixed an issue causing status effect duration not syncing to the client
[*] Fixed an issue causing hosts not to appear with the [Host] tag in lobby
[/list]

notes.title: Deadlokk Content Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
We’ve decided our next update will be our larger update for the entire game. This update will include many new features, improvements and a lot more content. The update to Expedition (PVE) will completely change how the game is played.

Expedition will now be a more complete and fleshed out roguelike mode, where you and up to 2 other people work together to survive as long as possible travelling through sectors and systems. Discovering new items, abilities, NPCs and many more secrets. Navigate through systems via the Starmap to choose routes that benefit you. Systems have specific objectives per jump gate, unlock these gates by completing the assigned objectives and  ensure to keep your Carrier fueled to travel as fast as possible against ever scaling NPCs.

Fight against all other factions in Deadlokk: Axiom, Innokkulum, Empyrean, Plague and Bhaede. Each faction having their own style which requires knowledge and specific setups to clear effectively.
We hope to bring this update to everyone soon in November.

Deadlokk Development Team,
Null Reference LTD

notes.title: Early Access Release Delay

Hello!

We have delayed our release for Deadlokk Early Access until 17th August 2021.

Thanks for understanding!
- Null Reference Team
